scope: The 24 open findings from docs/audits/bidi-scene-review.json, classified from the current oracle report and the rendered visual order. Classification is an analysis, not a waiver. No finding is resolved by this file.

C1-neutral-attribution.title: Oracle attributes sentence-final or operator punctuation to the adjacent English run
C1-neutral-attribution.decisionNeeded: Owner must approve an explicit oracle attribution rule (or accept the sentence-period/operator placement). Wrapping the Arabic sentence in an RTL span was tested and does not change the oracle result.

C2-native-select-hidden-options.title: Native <select>: oracle concatenates unselected option text
C2-native-select-hidden-options.decisionNeeded: Owner must decide whether the audit should measure only the displayed selected option. Requires an oracle change plus Chromium proof of the displayed value.

C3-independent-tags.title: Independent topic tags in an RTL flex row; oracle treats adjacent tags as a translation pair
C3-independent-tags.decisionNeeded: Owner must classify the tags as independent (non-pair) with an explicit contract, or request a tag-order change in the layout.

C4-arabic-connective-flow.title: English item followed by an Arabic connective/contrast inside one sentence; RTL logical order conflicts with the English=Arabic pair policy
C4-arabic-connective-flow.decisionNeeded: Owner must choose: accept RTL sentence reading order for these flows (oracle contract change) or require English-first visual layout (source/layout change).

C5-cross-clause-dash.title: Two clauses joined by an em dash: English of one clause pairs with the Arabic label of the next
C5-cross-clause-dash.decisionNeeded: Owner must approve a clause-level regrouping or visual reorder for this caption. Wording-preservation check forbids reordering the DOM text.
